# complies with

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:complies`](gmeow-complies.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/complies>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/norms`](../../slices/norms.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

Flat shortcut: the event complies with the norm — according to whoever asserts it. The positive twin of [`gmeow:violates`](gmeow-violates.md); same promotion path, same never-entailed doctrine.

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:Event`](../classes/gmeow-Event.md) -> [`gmeow:Norm`](../classes/gmeow-Norm.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:complies`](gmeow-complies.md) from [`gmeow:Event`](../classes/gmeow-Event.md) to [`gmeow:Norm`](../classes/gmeow-Norm.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use for the flat case — recording that an event complies with a norm according to whoever asserts it (the positive twin of [`gmeow:violates`](gmeow-violates.md)).

### Avoid when

- Avoid reading it as an entailment (compliance is always somebody's judgement) and avoid it when the assessor, evidence, or confidence must be first-class (promote to [`gmeow:ComplianceAssessment`](../classes/gmeow-ComplianceAssessment.md)).

### How to use

- Assert [`gmeow:complies`](gmeow-complies.md) from the [`gmeow:Event`](../classes/gmeow-Event.md) to the [`gmeow:Norm`](../classes/gmeow-Norm.md), indexed on the statement layer; reify to [`gmeow:ComplianceAssessment`](../classes/gmeow-ComplianceAssessment.md) when the judgement's provenance matters.
